description.zh: 在聊天里实时渲染 shader：AI 回复中写出 <shader>…</shader>（Shadertoy 风格 GLSL），聊天里就出现一块**持续的活画面**而不是截图。附一个工具 shader_last_compile_result，让 AI 能读回 GLSL 编译器报错原文并自己改到编译通过。渲染页面是编译期内联的自包含 HTML —— 运行时不碰网络、不碰文件系统、不碰资源拦截。
description.en: Render shaders live inside the chat: when the AI writes <shader>…</shader> (Shadertoy-style GLSL) in a reply, it appears as a continuously animating block instead of a screenshot. Ships one tool, shader_last_compile_result, so the AI can read back the raw GLSL compiler errors and fix the code until it compiles. The render page is a self-contained HTML string inlined at build time — no network, no filesystem and no resource interception at runtime.
